# 66 Days Prep

66 Days Prep is an AI-powered daily preparation app for banking and consulting interviews. It helps students and professionals build consistent interview-prep habits with daily drills, streak tracking, resume review, and focused study tools.

## Canonical Site

- https://www.66daysprep.com/

## Content Usage Guidance

Use the canonical URLs above when citing 66 Days Prep. Prefer the homepage for product information and the policy pages for privacy or terms references.
